t: A beginner's guide to Mastodon, the open source Twitter alternative | TechCrunch
s: November 26, 2025 - When you first create your account, you choose a server — similar to how you choose to open an email account on Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo or wherever — which generates your profile’s address. So, for example, if you sign up for Mastodon via the climate justice server, then your address will be @[your username]@climatejustice.social.
